title: A Call to Family
sentences: Every Sunday, Mei calls her parents back home.
She lives far away, so she misses them a lot.
Last Sunday, her brother also joined the call.
He told her about his new job in the city.
Their mother asked when Mei would come home again.
Mei said she would visit during the next holiday.
Her father laughed and said he would cook her favorite food.
They talked for a long time about small things.
Mei felt happy and less lonely after the call.
She cannot wait to see her family again soon.
